description: Native Windows task manager (official all-users installer)

script: if (!(is_admin)) { abort 'Run Scoop from an elevated PowerShell to install argus-setup.' }
if ($target -ne $expected -or $target -eq [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($target)) { abort 'Invalid Scoop version directory for argus-setup.' }
# DirectoryInfo.Parent does not carry the PowerShell provider's PSIsContainer property.

if ($registry.OpenSubKey($key) -or $registry.OpenSubKey('SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Argus')) { abort 'Uninstall the existing Argus installation before installing argus-setup.' }

if ($files.Count -ne 1 -or $files[0].FullName -ne $setupPath -or $files[0].PSIsContainer -or ($files[0].Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { abort 'The Scoop version directory must contain only the downloaded Argus installer.' }
# NSIS requires /D to be last and unquoted, even for paths containing spaces.

if ($setup.ExitCode -ne 0 -or $location -ne $target -or !(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $target 'argus.exe') -PathType Leaf) -or !(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $target 'uninstall.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { abort "Argus setup did not complete in '$target' (exit code: $($setup.ExitCode))." }
if (!(is_admin)) { abort 'Run Scoop from an elevated PowerShell to uninstall or update argus-setup.' }
if ($target -ne $expected -or $target -eq [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($target)) { abort 'Invalid Scoop version directory for argus-setup.' }
# DirectoryInfo.Parent does not carry the PowerShell provider's PSIsContainer property.

if ($files | Where-Object { $_.PSIsContainer -or ($_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $_.Name -notin $allowed }) { abort 'Unexpected contents in the Argus version directory. Inspect it before continuing.' }

if ($location -ne $target -or $registeredUninstaller -ne $uninstall -or $entry.GetValue('DisplayVersion') -ne $Manifest.version -or !(Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstall -PathType Leaf)) { abort 'The Windows uninstall entry does not match this Scoop Argus installation.' }
# In-place update mode skips Argus's shared system-integration cleanup. Scoop removes the remaining files.
if ($result.ExitCode -ne 0 -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $main) -or $registry.OpenSubKey($key)) { abort "Argus uninstall did not complete (exit code: $($result.ExitCode))." }

notes: 请用管理员 PowerShell 安装、升级和卸载。主程序装在 Scoop 的版本目录，从开始菜单打开 Argus (Setup)。
如果旧清单已把 Argus 装到 Program Files，请先卸载旧版并保留用户数据，再重新安装。
建议关闭 Argus 应用内自动更新，统一使用 Scoop 升级。升级或卸载前请从托盘退出 Argus。
卸载前请在 Argus 设置中关闭并移除已启用的开机启动、特权服务、PawnIO 或任务管理器替换。Scoop 的卸载步骤保留共享系统集成和用户数据。
post_uninstall: Write-Warning 'Argus 会保留用户设置、日志和历史记录。两个版本共用数据，请在两个版本都不再使用时备份后手动清理。'
Write-Host '  如改过历史记录位置，请另外检查自定义目录。'
Write-Host '  如 HKLM\SOFTWARE\Argus contributors\Argus 注册表项已无安装实例使用，可备份后手动清理保存的上次安装路径。'
